text:
leo_sales: Heads up — Akacorp POC blocked by SSO+SCIM flakiness on their Private deployment. They cant finish user provisioning or sign in for the demo.

sam_pse: Which control plane are they pointed at? Hosted or their tenant in private?

leo_sales: Private tenant URL. They used the quickstart hosted metadata earlier which worked for hosted tests but not for the Private control plane. After switching to Private, SAML responses error with Audience and Destination mismatch.

nina_eng: Audience/Destination mismatch usually means the IdP still has the old EntityID/ACS. Please confirm metadata they imported. We expose `https://console.private.redwood-inference.com/<tenant-id>/saml/metadata` for private tenants.

leo_sales: They said they uploaded "redwood-saml.xml" from our docs but not the tenant-specific one.

tara_platform: Also saw SCIM creating duplicate accounts. Okta is POSTing users twice because it retries when it doesn't see a 200/204 on the first response. Our SCIM returns 201 and a Location header; some Okta apps expect 200 for PATCH flows.

sam_pse: Can you paste the Okta request/response logs?

tara_platform: Okta logs:
`POST /scim/v2/Users`
`Request body: {"userName":"joe+test@akacorp.com","name":{"givenName":"Joe","familyName":"User"}}`
`Response: 201 Created, Location: /scim/v2/Users/abc123`
Then a second identical POST 5s later. Okta later shows two users: `joe+test@akacorp.com` and `joe.test@akacorp.com` — there's an Okta transform rule that rewrites `+` to `.`.

nina_eng: Two things to fix: 1) Recommend mapping Okta `externalId` to SCIM `externalId` so the IdP and Redwood have a stable unique key. 2) Add case- and punctuation-normalization in the tenant SCIM matcher; we can turn on a `normalize_email` flag for this tenant.

leo_sales: The IdP admin also mentioned certificate mismatch in metadata validation — our metadata cert thumbprint doesn't match what they have.

nina_eng: That happens if they imported an older metadata file. I'll regenerate tenant metadata and share a signed XML. Sam, can you tell them to re-import and to set ACS/Destination to `https://console.private.redwood-inference.com/<tenant-id>/saml/consume` and EntityID to `https://console.private.redwood-inference.com/<tenant-id>/saml/metadata`?

sam_pse: On the operational side — if they need a quick workaround for demo, we can stand up a temporary hosted demo tenant and give them hosted API keys (not ideal for production). But we must warn about data separation.

tara_platform: Also note: Okta SCIM client sometimes sends Authorization as `Bearer <token>` vs `SSWS <token>` — our SCIM endpoint accepts Bearer but some older clients expect SSWS. Confirm their client type.

leo_sales: Demo is tomorrow at 10am PT. If we regenerate metadata now and they re-import, can we validate before the demo?

nina_eng: If they re-import and fix ACS/EntityID and mapping we can run an end-to-end check in ~3 hours. I can also enable normalize_email for the tenant immediately to prevent duplicates.

sam_pse: Pricing note — extending the Dedicated POC for an hour to cover the fix is fine. If they request a second POC environment we'll need formal approval.

deploy_bot: Note: Temporary hosted demo tokens issued: `demo-hosted-akacorp-01` (expires in 72h).

leo_sales: Cool. Assigning owners: @nina_eng to regenerate metadata + enable email normalization; @tara_platform to write step-by-step SCIM mapping doc for Akacorp (screenshots + Okta rule hints); @sam_pse to coordinate with Akacorp IdP admin and confirm import. I'll ping when they confirm import.

tara_platform: I'll post the short Okta mapping checklist in 10m.

nina_eng: Scheduling a 30-min verification window in 2 hours.

sam_pse: I'll keep Akacorp on standby and share our meeting link.
